name: Rewiring America
summary: A US nonprofit in Washington, DC, founded in 2020, working to electrify American homes: it designed the Inflation Reduction Act's home-electrification rebates, runs free tools that show households the incentives for heat pumps and other electric appliances, trains electrification coaches and advises states, cities and utilities. A project of the Windward Fund until July 2024.
